svg.title: BOD dilution: two percent sample and five mg per litre oxygen depletion
svg.desc: The incubation mixture contains 2 percent wastewater and 98 percent dilution water by volume. Its measured five-day oxygen depletion is 5 mg per litre. With no seed or blank demand, divide by 0.02 to obtain 250 mg per litre BOD of the original wastewater.

g.text: BOD: distinguish mixture from original sample
Volume fraction in the incubation mixture
Mixture depletion: 5 mg/L after 5 days at 20°C
No seed or blank demand assumed. Correct those demands when present.
